sentences.en: Successive economic crises long ago became an ideological soap opera.
sentences.zh: 接连不断的经济危机很久以前就变成了一场意识形态的肥皂剧。

sentences.en: She did not agree with the ideological aims of the group.
sentences.zh: 她不同意该组织的思想目标。

sentences.en: Doping is not compatible with my ideological views on the sport.
sentences.zh: 兴奋剂与我对这项运动的思想观点不相容。
